reason: I'd upload one group export for the free check out of curiosity, and if it finds a duplicate I'd be annoyed with my crew, but I'm not paying $19 a month every month when Excel and my own eyes on the screenshots cost nothing. After the 40 free documents I'd most likely just stop.
objection: It's another subscription for something I feel I can already do for free in Excel or with a simple bot, and I'm not convinced it would catch enough each month to pay for itself.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check actually found real money lost in my group, more than a few months of the fee, I'd pay for at least one month to see if it keeps catching things.
